teaser: Join us as a Senior Software Technical Leader, Duo Identity AI, where you will define technical direction for Cisco Identity’s privileged access capabilities. description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/17/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Preferred candidates will be based in Ann Arbor, MI or Austin, TX. Remote candidates will be considered.

Meet the Team

In an era where identity is the new perimeter, the traditional boundaries of cybersecurity are being redefined. At Cisco Security, our Identity AI team is at the forefront of this transformation, building "identity-first" solutions that go beyond simple authentication. We are looking for a visionary Software Leader to help us bridge the critical gap between verifying who a user is and validating the intent behind their actions.

By joining our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Cisco Identity Intelligence and Duo, architecting intelligent, adaptive systems that protect the digital fabric of the world’s most critical infrastructures. If you are passionate about building scalable, AI-driven security platforms and want to solve the industry’s most complex access challenges, this is your opportunity to lead innovation at the intersection of security and intelligence.

Your Impact

In this role, you will serve as a key technical leader in building the next generation of privileged access platform capabilities within Cisco Identity. You will define scalable architectures, guide complex cross-product integrations, and help turn emerging customer needs into secure, enterprise-ready solutions that strengthen the broader Identity strategy.  Key responsibilities include:

Architectural Leadership & Strategy:  Define the technical direction for identity and privileged access capabilities, establishing scalable architectures and patterns that can support a broad range of enterprise security use cases across Cisco's identity platform.

Identity & Platform Innovation: Lead the design and delivery of security capabilities that reduce standing privilege and give customers greater control over access to critical resources. Help evolve early customer-preview functionality into secure, intuitive, enterprise-ready experiences that can support a broad range of infrastructure and access scenarios. Balance near-term product needs with longer-term platform investments that enable consistent security outcomes across Cisco Identity.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Translate complex customer security requirements into practical technical solutions. Navigate ambiguity across engineering, product, design, and partner teams. Influence architectural decisions across organizational boundaries, establish effective collaboration patterns, and help other Identity teams navigate the technical and organizational challenges of building integrated security experiences at scale.

Operational Excellence & Reliability: Influence production readiness and operational maturity. Use your deep expertise to build resilient, self-healing systems to ensure that our infrastructure is not only scalable but also highly observable, maintaining the rigorous uptime and performance standards required by our global customer base.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of industry experience, or Masters and 8+ years of industry experience, or PhD and 6+ years of industry experience 

Experience in AI-driven development experience to include writing code, building systems, and developing strategies for using AI  to assist in work

Experience building cloud services to include AWS, GCP or Azure

Preferred Qualifications   

Experience with Kafka, data infrastructure, and/or streaming architecture to include building and operating production systems 

Experience in Identity and Security domains

Experience in a Saas

SRE/operations experience to run this infrastructure reliably in production to include a SRE mindset for observability, incident response, capacity planning, and reliability

Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify technical solutions and paths forward

Ability to influence without authority

Ability to continuously iterate and make decisions with a bias of action

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $177,600.00 to $257,400.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.
